title: Shelly Sewing Machine Plug Power Leaderboard
dataSources: Ravelry projects (`ravelry:project`), knitCompanion row counters (`knitcompanion:counter`), Shelly smart-plug machine runtime (`shelly:status`), and Ravelry stash entries (`ravelry:stash`).
app: Ravelry project and stash exports, knitCompanion row-counter logs, and Shelly plug telemetry for sewing-machine hours sent to Splunk.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=shelly:status power_watts=*
| stats sum(power_watts) as total_value, avg(power_watts) as avg_value by machine_name
| sort - total_value
description: Ranks machine name values by total and average power across Shelly sewing machine plug events.
value: Leaderboards help you see which people, devices, places, or projects dominate the signal.
implementation: Ingest numeric `power_watts` values for each Shelly sewing machine plug event and review total and average power by machine name.
visualization: Table of entities ranked by total power.
grandmaExplanation: It celebrates which machine name shows the biggest power numbers in your Shelly sewing machine plug data.
